dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply falcate trailing edge with a pronounced concave curvature fitting a parabolic spline from the posterior apex to the lower insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small pixel radius, classified as a rounded-acute apex with a slight posterior lean.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderate convex slope, approximately 35-40 degrees relative to the visible horizontal dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.8:1 maximum base width to maximum vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular depigmented scar tissue patch occupying the central and posterior lateral surface of the dorsal fin; a small notch-like indentation is visible on the upper third of the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Textural mottling and high-contrast pigmentation boundaries within the scarred region of the fin.
